subject: Request: per-route cost & latency signal crosswalk for procurement
messages:
From: Lara Jensen <lara@greenlab.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Per-route cost/latency signals for procurement — need mapping

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing the PO and procurement paperwork for the next quarter and need a clear mapping from the Redwood Console routes we use to the billing/product codes that will appear on invoices. Specifically GreenLab needs: 

- a CSV that maps "route_id" -> "console_route_name" -> "product_code/line_item"
- per-route token counts and p95 latency for the last 30 days (sample window: 2027-02-09 -> 2027-03-10)
- any notes about attribution caveats (shared batching, cached prefixes, model quantization differences) that could affect estimated spend

I attached our procurement template — the purchasing team also asked for a short paragraph we can paste into the PO describing what the charges represent. Can you provide the mapping and a quick explanation by end of day Friday? If it's easier to do a short call, I'm available 3/11 after 1pm PT.

Thanks,
Lara Jensen
Head of Platform Ops, GreenLab
FinanceOps <procure@greenlab.ai>
Attachment: greenlab_procurement_template.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lara Jensen <lara@greenlab.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Per-route cost/latency signals for procurement — need mapping

Hi Lara,

Thanks for the template and clear list. Happy to help — looped in Markus (product/console) and Grace (console instrumentation) so we can give you a tidy export and the paragraph for the PO. Quick notes / questions from our side: 

- Do you need the mapping down to tenant-level (i.e., per-tenant usage for each route) or is a per-route aggregate sufficient for the PO?
- For the latency numbers, we can provide p50/p95 and a short note about sampling windows (we typically compute p95 over steady-state traffic only).
- If you want breakdowns by model variant (e.g., gptx-std vs gptx-quant), tell us which scope matters.

I'll prepare a sample CSV (see attached sample-route-export.csv) and proposed PO paragraph. Can we schedule a 30m sync on 3/12 at 10am PT to confirm? If that doesn't work, share a preferred slot and we'll adapt.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-route-export.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Per-route cost/latency signals for procurement — need mapping

On Thu, Mar 11, 2027 at 11:03 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll prepare a sample CSV...

Hi all,

Quick technical context to avoid surprises in the procurement document:

- What we can provide easily from the Console: per-route token counts (total tokens in/out), average response time, p95/p99 latency, model variant, region, and a route label.
- Caveats: cost per token reported on invoices is the result of multiple layers — model variant, batching efficiency, KV cache hits, quantization, and any server-side aggregation. That means the raw token->USD mapping can differ slightly from a simple per-token multiplication (we see differences up to ~6% for some high-batch routes).
- Recommendation (two options):
  1) Quick export: one-off CSV with the fields Lara requested + a short paragraph describing attribution caveats (fast, good for PO).
  2) Repeatable export: scheduled daily export that your finance team can ingest; includes a small reconciliation script we can provide to align daily usage with invoice lines.

I'll attach the proposed route export schema and a short example of the reconciliation notes. If GreenLab needs exact invoice-level certainty for committed spend we can coordinate an invoice preview as part of the contract process.

-Markus
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Console
Attachment: route_export_schema.md

- We have a standard "invoice estimate" template I can populate once Markus's CSV is finalized — would you like an estimate for Q2 (Apr-Jun) based on Feb usage scaled to expected growth (+10%)?
- Deal ID for internal tracking: GL-2027-42 — include that on the PO if you want our finance team to link it automatically.

If a short call helps to close this, Kim — please confirm the 3/12 10am PT slot and I can join to run through the billing guide live.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
